title: SpecUP Traceability Graph
description: Canonical relation store (specup.md s20-s22). Edges are stored ONCE in active voice; inverses are derived at load time, which is what makes bi-directional traversal mechanical rather than a second hand-maintained dataset. traceability.md and coverage.md are generated views (s47).

source_file.description: File this edge is declared in.

derived_by.description: Required when provenance is 'derived': the rule in derivers.py that produced this edge. This schema can only require the field to be PRESENT - validate_trace.py TRC-010 is what re-runs the named rule and fails the edge if it does not reproduce it, which is what stops 'derived' from being a label anyone can type. Derived edges are regenerated wholesale into the machine-owned store and must never be hand-edited.

approved_endpoints_hash.description: SHA256 of the endpoint artifacts at approval time. If the endpoints change, the edge is downgraded to 'asserted' and the downgrade is recorded - approval does not survive a change to what was approved (ID-GRAMMAR.md s3).

scope.description: Which slice of the project this file covers, e.g. 'specs/001-auth'. Per-feature matrices are merged into one graph at load time; see openup-config.yml traceability.stores.

$comment: Graph-level invariants enforced by validate_trace.py: (1) both endpoints resolve to an artifact that exists, or the edge is 'broken'; (2) relation is type-legal for its endpoints per the domain/range table in ID-GRAMMAR.md s2; (3) no duplicate (from, relation, to) triples across merged stores; (4) no cycles on contains, decomposes-to, refines, depends-on, supersedes; (5) forward coverage - every requirement reaches an implementing WBS node and a verifying acceptance criterion; (6) backward coverage - every source file inside the configured traceability perimeter is reachable from some requirement; (7) orphan detection per s54, scoped by the perimeter; (8) the derived:asserted:approved ratio is reported, so a graph that is overwhelmingly 'asserted' cannot present itself as 100% covered; (9) every 'derived' edge is re-derived by the rule it names, and the ones naming a rule that is not implemented are counted separately rather than trusted; (10) the store must contain every edge the implemented rules produce; (11) every acceptance criterion has at least one scenario executing it (s24).
